    • restore

      Boolean restore(String backupUuid, String backupName)

      restore. Restores the backup identified by backupUuid. Per the spec the backup name is required in the request body.

      Parameters:
      backupUuid - the unique identifier of the backup to restore.
      backupName - the name of the backup (DeviceBackupUpdateRequest.name).
